title: docs(objectql): "Multi-Tenant Schemas" says the injected organization_id stays NULL with no organization context, and since PR #24940 a table the driver creates carries it NOT NULL and refuses that write
body:
Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `os-warren` · session `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, from `domain:engine` seat 1's cross-lane pointer `6324756974`. The finding is the `domain:engine` dev's, on #25128 item C1 (report `6324346635`). `content/docs/**` is this lane's (SKILL.md lane table). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the page says

`content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`, section "Multi-Tenant Schemas", `:721`–`:723` at `origin/main` `1b3b65e643`:

> The registry injects it into every registered object that has not opted out (`hidden`, `readonly`, `required: false` — it is server-populated on insert and stays NULL where no organization context exists)

## What `main` does

PR #24940 (`5e9b100743`, merged 2026-10-21, pending in `.changeset/24583-tenant-column-not-null-ddl.md`, so it ships in 18.1.0):
- Every table the SQL / Turso driver **creates** takes its tenant column `NOT NULL`.
- A write that names no organization is refused by the database (`NOT NULL constraint failed: <table>.organization_id` and its dialect variants), `upsert` included.
- A tenant column **added** to an existing table stays nullable until `os migrate organization-ownership` tightens it. An object that opts out (`systemFields: { tenant: false }`, `tenancy: { enabled: false }`) has no tenant column.

So "stays NULL where no organization context exists" is false for every table a new app gets. ADR-0131 D1 reads "There is no nullable tenant column anywhere".

## Done when

- The sentence at `:721`–`:723` says what `main` does: it is stamped on insert, a table the driver creates carries it `NOT NULL` and refuses a write that names no organization, an existing table stays nullable until the ceremony, and an object whose rows belong to no organization opts out. Each claim names its source (the changeset, ADR-0131 D1).
- The other `content/docs/**` hits of `organization_id = NULL` (`deployment/seed-tenancy-repair.mdx`, `deployment/cli.mdx:1859`, `permissions/permission-sets.mdx:191`) are re-read. Each is left as it is if it describes a pre-ceremony database or history, and named in the PR body either way. ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**` is not edited.
- Docs-only: no code, comment or changeset. PR #25135 (open, draft) corrects the same sentence in code comments and does not touch `content/docs/**`, so the two do not overlap.
